crew_status.EN-US: From our assessment, additional specialized resources are required to help complete the work. These teams may include tree crews or others with specialized equipment and skills needed for this type of repair. We apologize for the inconvenience and are moving quickly to get the right people and equipment in place and restore service safely.

Estos equipos pueden incluir cuadrillas de arboricultura u otros grupos que cuenten con la maquinaria y las competencias específicas necesarias para este tipo de reparación. Lamentamos los inconvenientes y estamos actuando con rapidez para movilizar al personal y el equipo adecuados, a fin de restablecer el servicio de manera segura.

crew_status.EN-US: Trained personnel are evaluating equipment and system conditions to determine what repairs are needed and whether additional resources or specialized equipment are required. This assessment helps ensure restoration work can be completed safely and as efficiently as possible. Thank you for your patience.

crew_status.EN-US: Our team is gathering information and identifying the resources needed to move restoration efforts forward as quickly as possible. Thank you for your patience while we work to get the lights back on.
